personal_info.summary: Frontend Developer with a hands-on approach and product mindset. I built complete applications such as Financer and a fully functional e-commerce from scratch, using React, Tailwind, and Firebase. I excel at delivering real-world solutions, focusing on user experience, and working autonomously with a results-driven mindset. I seek to join teams where I can grow, contribute, and provide value from day one.
